name: Kenji Alvarez-Okonkwo
role: Evidence removal and scene sanitation — cleaner
location: Geartown — industrial district of chop shops and fabricators, near Damen and Armitage
description:
Kenji Alvarez-Okonkwo is athletic and fluid, the kind of body that suggests either dancer or fighter — and in GLMZ, the distinction is academic. At 41, his face carries the layered heritage of generations of diaspora mixing — features that resist easy categorization and reward attention. The chrome is visible — cybernetic eyes with thermal overlay and low-light enhancement — chrome iris rin — and he makes no effort to hide it.

He used to be somebody else, in another city, with another name — that person is officially dead, and Kenji Alvarez-Okonkwo plans to keep it that way. He works as a cleaner out of Geartown, taking contracts that match his skills and his risk tolerance, which is higher than most people consider healthy.

Kenji Alvarez-Okonkwo has built a reputation on reliability rather than flash — he shows up, he delivers, he collects.

core_fears: The quiet — silence means something is about to go very wrong
Losing control of their own body to a hacker or malfunctioning cyberware
Never being able to stop running — the lifestyle is a trap disguised as freedom
core_desires: To matter to someone for who they are, not what they can do
The perfect run — one job so clean it becomes legend
Power — enough leverage that nobody ever threatens them again
coping_mechanisms: Violence — hits something when they can't process emotions, preferably something that deserves it
Connection — finds someone to talk to, even if it's a bartender or a cat
Control — micromanages everything within reach to compensate for the chaos everywhere else
blind_spots: Assumes everyone has an angle because they always have an angle
Mistakes pattern recognition for wisdom — sees connections that aren't there
Cannot accept help without interpreting it as leverage
psychology.secret: Kenji Alvarez-Okonkwo sends anonymous tips to GLMZ law enforcement about competitors. It's not principle — it's market manipulation.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Warm and personable on the surface, with an undertone that suggests the warmth is a professional tool.
speech_patterns.cadence: Conversational and disarming — sounds like a neighbor until the content registers.
verbal_tics: Ends statements with 'yeah?' — not a question, a dare
Addresses people by physical traits — 'hey, tall one' or 'listen, chrome-arm'
example_lines: "I make problems disappear. The mess is temporary. The clean is permanent."
"There was never anyone here. There was never anything here. Are we clear?"
"Forensics is a conversation between evidence and investigators. I end that conversation."

story_hooks: Kenji Alvarez-Okonkwo is offered a contract that would clear all their debts — the target is someone they respect
A high-paying contract turns out to target someone Kenji Alvarez-Okonkwo owes a personal debt to
Kenji Alvarez-Okonkwo's augmentations begin malfunctioning in the field — sabotage or degradation, and either answer is bad
narrative_function: Kenji Alvarez-Okonkwo represents the working professional of the runner world — competent, reliable, and slowly being consumed by a lifestyle that doesn't accommodate aging or doubt. His stories explore what happens when skill meets systemic injustice.
augmentations: Cybernetic eyes with thermal overlay and low-light enhancement — chrome iris rings. Thermal masking system — body heat signature can be suppressed or spoofed
daily_life: Between contracts, maintains a cover identity — mundane work, mundane hours, mundane neighbors. The transition from civilian to runner and back requires a conscious effort that gets easier with practice and more disturbing with self-awareness.

strengths: ability to remain calm under fire
weaknesses: augmentation dependency — performance drops sharply if chrome malfunctions
old injury that flares under specific conditions

decision_rules: Will not take contracts against children or families — the line is hard and non-negotiable
Never discusses active contracts with anyone not directly involved
Will not betray a client who paid in full, regardless of better offers
Refuses contracts that require operating inside The Spires — too much surveillance
escalation_ladder: 2. Evade — avoid the problem entirely if possible
3. Misdirect — create a distraction, redirect attention
4. Disable — targeted takedowns, quiet and efficient
5. Eliminate — when silence is no longer an option
6. Vanish — disappear completely, burn identity if necessary

interpersonal_modes.employers: Carefully managed deference that conceals a thorough assessment of their vulnerabilities.
interpersonal_modes.crew: Warm and protective within the crew, cold to everyone outside it. The circle is small by design.
interpersonal_modes.strangers: Superficially friendly, internally cataloguing exits and weapons. The smile is real; the relaxation isn't.
interpersonal_modes.threats: Predatory focus. Threats are problems, and problems have solutions. The solution is usually kinetic.

stress_responses.low: Becomes more talkative, working through scenarios verbally.
stress_responses.medium: Becomes curt and demanding. Efficiency overrides courtesy.
stress_responses.high: Hyper-focused tunnel vision. Peripheral concerns disappear. Only the threat exists.
stress_responses.critical: Berserker clarity. Everything becomes simple: survive. Deal with the rest later. The simplicity is almost peaceful.

contradictions: Despises corporate culture but has unconsciously adopted its efficiency metrics and self-optimization language
Preaches independence but is desperate for approval from people they respect
habits: Carries a specific caliber round as a lucky charm — has never fired it
Maintains a dead drop with emergency supplies in three separate districts
Keeps a physical paper notebook — no digital record of personal thoughts
Practices a kata or fighting form every morning regardless of circumstances
breaking_points: Learning that a job they completed resulted in mass casualties they weren't told about
Losing their primary augmentation — the one that defines their professional identity

cyberware_inventory.name: Cybernetic eyes with thermal overlay and low-light enhancement
cyberware_inventory.description: Cybernetic eyes with thermal overlay and low-light enhancement — chrome iris rings

cyberware_inventory.name: Thermal masking system
cyberware_inventory.description: Thermal masking system — body heat signature can be suppressed or spoofed

physical_description.build: Athletic and lean with functional muscle — the physique of someone who moves deliberately and trains consistently. Shoulders suggest swimmer's development; core is tight. No wasted mass.
physical_description.hair_color: Black with premature silver threading at temples
physical_description.hair_style: Neat, close-cropped. Maintained regularly. No statement, no rebellion — practical.
physical_description.eye_color: Chrome iris rings over dark brown pupils — cybernetic enhancement with visible metallic sheen
physical_description.skin_tone: Medium-deep olive undertone, sun-weathered to golden-brown
physical_description.complexion: Sharp cheekbones and defined jaw suggest both discipline and genetic luck. Minimal facial hair — clean-shaven or very close trim. Skin shows minor scarring consistent with industrial work — nothing theatrical. Expression tends toward neutral observation.
distinguishing_marks: Thermal masking system scar tissue pattern along left collarbone and upper chest — thin silvered lines where subdermal heat-dispersal implants anchor
Burn scar on right forearm, approximately 8cm length, pale and old — deliberately non-augmented, left unrepaired as if intentional
Small tattoo on inner left wrist — geometric symbol, dark ink, minimal line work, appears functional rather than decorative
physical_description.visible_augmentations: Cybernetic eyes are the primary visible modification — chrome iris rings catch light distinctly, pupils respond to thermal data inputs with slight lag. Eyes appear to refocus differently than baseline human vision. The thermal masking system is invisible unless imaging equipment detects it — body heat signature anomalies are the only tell.
physical_description.posture_movement: Moves with controlled economy — no wasted motion. Appears to be scanning environments constantly, head movements precise. Stands with weight slightly forward, ready to shift direction. Handshakes are firm but measured. Speech patterns are clipped, direct — minimal affect. Resting state is alert.
physical_description.clothing_style: Tier 3-4 functional wear — fitted dark synthweave cargo pants with subtle reinforced seams, technical-grade footwear (non-branded, maintenance-focused). Layered tops allow thermal regulation and concealment — typically dark colors. Minimal branding. Everything is chosen for mobility and durability over fashion. A lightweight jacket with multiple sealed pockets is standard. No jewelry. No personal flair.
